integrity: All theorem claims are derived analytically. The checker is corroborative only. Closely related inaccessible full texts are retained as originality risks rather than treated as non-covering evidence.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact scalar reduction and a necessary outer parameter obstruction. It does not prove Liu’s conjecture on \([0.48,1.36]\), does not assert sufficiency throughout the outer interval, and does not claim the boundary family is the globally strongest possible obstruction.
title: Exact boundary obstruction for Liu’s parameterized Erdős–Mordell conjecture
